name: ByetHost
tagline: Free ad-free web hosting with optional NVMe cPanel premium tiers
description: ByetHost offers free web hosting with no forced ads plus paid NVMe cPanel plans for sites that outgrow the free tier's limits.
about: ByetHost is a free web hosting provider that has run since the 2000s as part of the Byet Internet Services family. Its free plan gives sites 5 GB of NVMe storage, unlimited bandwidth (subject to a roughly 50,000-hits-per-day fair-use ceiling), a custom subdomain or a connected domain you already own, PHP 8.3, MySQL 8, free SSL, FTP access and Softaculous with 400+ one-click app installs — all without injecting forced ads or banners, which sets it apart from many other free hosts. The account never expires as long as it stays active, but the free tier is limited to a single FTP account and a hard 10MB per-file upload cap, both of which make it awkward for anything beyond a small site, blog or test project.

For sites that need more room, ByetHost sells three paid NVMe-backed shared hosting tiers on cPanel with Softaculous: Starter at $29.99/year (10 GB storage, 250 GB monthly bandwidth, 1 addon domain, 1 free domain), Super Premium at $56.78/year (unlimited NVMe storage, 250 GB monthly bandwidth, 20 addon domains, 1 free domain plus 20 bonus domain extensions), and Ultimate Premium at $85.22/year (unlimited storage and bandwidth, unlimited addon domains). All three paid tiers include free SSL and swap the free plan's VistaPanel for a full cPanel, which is the more familiar industry-standard control panel.

In short, ByetHost works best as a genuinely free way to get a small site or test project online without ads, with a paid upgrade path available if the project grows — but it isn't built to compete with mainstream budget hosts on raw reliability or support responsiveness at the free tier.
policies: The free plan has no fixed contract and no money-back guarantee since no payment is involved; ByetHost can suspend inactive free accounts, so sites need occasional login activity to stay online.
Paid Starter, Super Premium and Ultimate Premium plans are billed annually; check ByetHost's own terms at checkout for the current refund window, as policies on paid tiers can change.
